newsitem.title: EGYPT: Citibank in Egypt sets interbank rates on screen.
newsitem.headline: Citibank in Egypt sets interbank rates on screen.

text.p: Citibank in Egypt said on Monday it has started quoting their Egyptian pound interbank rates on screens in a move it said aims to develop the market's role as a benchmark for interest rates.
Citibank rates can be seen on Reuters page CITX.

"Rates will be quoted up to six months. These rates are good for a minimum amount of three million pounds ($900,000) with any amount above that being mutually negotiated.." the bank said in a press release.
It said the new quotation system, which started on Sunday, aimed to create a "more efficient interbank market".

The bank said that "due to current market liquidity and depth, the bid/offer spread is somewhat wide, but expected to drop to international levels as market depth and number of participants increase."
